<MethodEndpoint

  path={"/api/instance_git_file_diff"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns the old and new content of a single file as it changed in the
given commit, read from the instance repo. Read-only, unlike the project
equivalent - there's no restore action for a single instance file.
